design.name: 夔
design.brief: Kui (夔), the one-legged thunder beast of the Shan Hai Jing ('like an ox, grey-blue, hornless, with ONE LEG; whenever it enters or leaves the water there is wind and rain; its light is like the sun and moon, its voice like thunder'), whose hide the Yellow Emperor made into a war drum. It returns as a storm revenant about 6 m tall: a colossal hornless ox head with blazing white-violet eyes, a massive hunched front body of grey-blue hide in big carved plates, a huge open ribcage on its chest framing a tattered round DRUM SKIN stretched over the ribs and painted with thunder spirals (the drum it lost), a glowing magenta-violet core behind the drum (weak spot). It stands on EXACTLY ONE thick central leg ending in a huge hoof (no second leg, no hind legs, like a pogo stick), with two shorter forelimbs ending in hoof-fists held like drumsticks; solid sculpted storm-cloud shapes trail from its shoulders. Majestic and terrifying.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
